name: Talisman of the Sphere

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Doubles your Proficiency Bonus on Arcana checks to control a Sphere of Annihilation, with Advantage.
text: Hold or wear this talisman when you try to take command of a Sphere of Annihilation: your Intelligence (Arcana) checks to do so add double your Proficiency Bonus and are made with Advantage. If you begin your turn controlling a Sphere, a Magic action lets you levitate it a distance of 10 feet plus 10 feet per point of your Intelligence modifier.
